label: Set instance values
description: Set and clear one instance's values for the program's `@instance_filled` fields in one go. Every value is checked against its field and node rules first; one refusal stores nothing. The instance's active triggers reading a changed value are re-armed with it before `rearmed` fires.

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: The instance id your program gives it (`user-42`).

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: Keyed by `node.field`: `{"read.spreadsheet": "1AbC...", "digest.cron": "0 0 7 * * *"}`. A connection field takes one of the instance's connections: `{"slack.account": {"id": "<connection id>"}}`.

inputs.name: clear
inputs.description: Fields to clear, as `node.field`; each falls back as if never given.

outputs.name: rearmed
outputs.description: The instance's triggers re-armed because they read a changed value.

then.message: SetInstanceValues '{id}' gives {names} in `values`, which is no field this program writes `@instance_filled`. Key each value by `node.field` the way the program writes it (`read.spreadsheet`, or `one.read.spreadsheet` inside an included file), naming a field written `@instance_filled`.

SetInstanceValues '{id}' clears {names}, which is no field this program writes `@instance_filled`. Name each as `node.field` the way the program writes it (`read.spreadsheet`, or `one.read.spreadsheet` inside an included file), naming a field written `@instance_filled`.
